description: Search California STATE government contract awards & purchase orders from the official State Contract and Procurement Registration System (SCPRS) on data.ca.gov. Each result is a State purchase order / award with its awarding department (agency), the winning supplier (vendor), the dollar amount, acquisition type/method, item description, and dates. Filter by supplier, department/agency, keyword, fiscal year, acquisition type, and/or a minimum amount; results are ranked by dollar amount (biggest awards first) by default. Use this for questions like "who won California state contracts", "biggest suppliers to the CA Department of Health Care Services", or "CA state purchase orders for laptops". This is CALIFORNIA STATE data (not federal).

acquisition_type.description: Acquisition type substring, e.g. "IT Goods", "NON-IT Services", "IT Services".

department.description: Awarding State department / agency name (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Health Care Services", "Transportation".

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the item name/description, e.g. "laptop", "consulting".

min_amount.description: Only return awards whose total price is at least this many dollars, e.g. 100000.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default 0).

sort.description: Sort order: "amount" = largest award first (default), "date" = most recent creation date first.

supplier.description: Winning supplier / vendor name to match (case-insensitive substring), e.g. "Microsoft", "Pitney Bowes".

name: ca_procurement_awards
title: Ca Procurement Awards
